items.problem: "decimal integer string" in the JSON value of a mail input has no definition in `mailbox`. admin-api.md:173 now defines the term only inside admin-api body rules (optional `-`, then `0` or digits that start with `1` to `9`), so `send_mail` of admin-api rejects `user_id` `"03"` with 400 while `mail.attachments[].amount` `"03"` can be accepted or be `INVALID_INPUT` depending on the `mailbox` implementation

How the `mail` JSON string of a `mailbox_broadcast` row writes `int64` values (`expire_ms`, `int_value` of an integer `MailArg`) and how step 2 of request start (mailbox.md:145) turns that string back into a mail input before `send_mail` are not set. A broadcast with an integer `MailArg` of 2^53+1 is delivered with that exact value when the row writes a decimal string or is read with an exact integer parser, and is lossy or skipped with an `error` log (as `INVALID_INPUT` under the rule of mailbox.md:64) when it is written as a JSON integer and read with `JSON.parse`
